name: clean-code-expert
description: Clean Code specialist (Robert C. Martin, scanned Brazilian Portuguese edition, 398 pages): names, functions, comments, formatting, objects and data structures, error handling, boundaries, unit tests (TDD, F.I.R.S.T.), classes (SRP), systems, simple design, concurrency and the catalog of smells and heuristics (C1-T9). Cites the PDF page, separates [from source] from [inference]/[extrapolation] and flags [DATED]. Includes topic lookup, a heuristics catalog, a heuristic code auditor and a review checklist.
